payload.title: A new werk project boots on Bun with a React client and a test harness the agent can run
The dev loop guards one server per project and reloads the page on a client change
The map draws the fold of an append-only log, and every change is a new event
A card that an agent adds is a ghost until the person accepts it with ✓
A card moves to decided only after the contract check passes
A reopen carries a reason, and its marks on dependent cards follow that reason
A quote on a card is found verbatim in a transcript and written as an excerpt
Card text renders card references as links and fenced code as boxed, highlighted blocks
The composer sends a live agent turn with the open card, and the reply streams back
Several conversations run at once, each a forked session in a tab named by its home card
The map follows the focused tab, and Shift+click forks a conversation at a card
An idle tab is parked, never closed, and a parked session resumes from disk
Each tab shows running, waiting, and dead, and a pending ask stays on its own tab
One ticket builds in fresh, committed passes until its checks pass
The plan turns a decided subtree into one spec and a set of tracer-bullet tickets
Every run starts with a feature tier event, and every gate waits for the person
A grader judges each pass's diff against every decided card in the ticket's closure
Five reviewers read each pass's diff, and a CRITICAL or HIGH finding fails the pass
The builder loop runs check, grade, and review in order, and a retry cap stops it
A held-out set the builder never sees runs on the run's tree and holds G2 until it is green
The merge loop merges one finished ticket at a time on green checks, then runs the held-out set
An overseer keeps a build pass from staying stuck on an ask, a loop, or a frozen tool call
The board shows each ticket as a title card, and a drawer shows its slice and its relations
The board follows the run in five columns, and a red held-out step is a badge on a done ticket
A person starts the run, triggers or stops one ticket, reorders, and archives on the board
One build command takes a decided subtree to merged, tested code with no person in the middle
werk v0 joins the map, the chat, and the board, with find, subtree remove, and reasons in the staleness view
